A gap this change makes worse before it makes it better

    
The agent's boundaries said media generation "runs through the fal MCP
       server granted to this agent". Its tools: list grants no
       mcp__fal__* tool at all. Documenting image generation on top of that would
       have told the agent to plan around a capability it cannot invoke, so the prose now
       states the grant is absent instead of asserting it.

    
prose      "the fal MCP server granted to this agent"   false
tools:     Bash, Read, Write, Edit, Grep, ...           no mcp__fal__*
now        "which this agent does NOT currently grant"  honest

    
Note that test-mcp-declared-vs-granted.sh passes either way:
       it compares frontmatter declarations, and this claim lived in prose. A gate cannot see a
       promise made in a sentence.
